tips: Gave away 43 m in the 30 s before the mark. Keep target speed on the layline; don't pinch up to the mark.
Gybed 10 s after the mark, so its cost is in this number. Fine if it was for clear air or the favoured side; otherwise hold the lane until you're up to speed.
Came out at 46° to the wind, low and wide (your best exited at 29°). Finish the turn close to close-hauled; the wide entry is what makes a tight exit possible.
Took 51 s to settle upwind (best 27 s). Trim main and jib on through the turn, then speed before height.
Lost 31 m on the way in. Drop earlier and set up wide so the turn starts before the mark, not at it.
Speed dropped 24% through the turn (7.5 → 5.67 kt; best 6%). A smoother, rounder turn with trim in step with the helm keeps more of it.
Overstood the layline by ~9°. Tack onto it a little sooner and sail the last 100 m at full upwind speed.
